issue_context.title: IB Error with Futures - "No security definition has been found for the request"
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
No error should be thrown.

#### Actual Behavior
When using futures with IB, the following error is thrown on Saturdays (at midnight in exchange time zone):
```
System.Exception: No security definition has been found for the request. Origin: FindContracts: ES (FUT ES USD )
```

This error is caused by `InteractiveBrokersBrokerage.LookupSymbols()` attempting to refresh the list of contracts in the futures chain during the IB weekend period: 
- `Connect` fails silently here:
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Brokerages/InteractiveBrokers/InteractiveBrokersBrokerage.cs#L2814
  This could potentially cause "Not connected" exceptions to be thrown also with options.
- `FindContracts` throws the error above:
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Brokerages/InteractiveBrokers/InteractiveBrokersBrokerage.cs#L2844

#### Potential Solution
- The IB brokerage should **never** attempt to connect or call other IB API methods when `IsWithinScheduledServerResetTimes()` is `true`.

#### Reproducing the Problem
n/a

#### System Information
n/a

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
- [ ] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue
comments:
The issue is still present -- IB `LookupSymbols` was called even if `IsWithinScheduledServerResetTimes()` was `true`:

```

2019-12-14T05:00:00.2942790Z TRACE:: InteractiveBrokersBrokerage.LookupSymbols(): Requesting symbol list for ES ... 
```
